title: Transfer: Rail Traction Peak Headway Stress
goal: Evaluate a rail traction power network under two timetable-driven injection patterns, then summarize substation angle profiles, feeder loadings, newly overloaded sections, and the corridors with the highest incremental stress during peak headway service.
skillBenefitRationale: This applies dc-power-flow to rail electrification, but the only critical shipped skill remains the same: represent the network with a susceptance matrix and compute how changing nodal injections shifts line flows and congestion.
